card.name: Stock wording in patent drawing descriptions
card.fires_on: Words in stock patent-application text, such as the heading BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS and the standard line 'The invention itself, however, as well as a preferred mode of use...'. It also fires on 'With reference now to the figures'.

modes.label: Drawings heading
modes.description: The end of the heading BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS, just before the first figure is described.
